pk.context: 40 mg oral, single dose, healthy adults

clues.kinetics: Absolute bioavailability is 63% in most patients and 94% in poor CYP2D6 metabolizers. Food leaves exposure unchanged but lowers peak concentration by 37%, and it is 98% protein bound.
clues.substance: A hydrochloride salt with a molecular weight of 255.35 for the active moiety. It has a solubility of 27.8 mg/mL in water.
clues.product: Approved under an NDA in several strengths, from 10 mg to 100 mg.
clues.safety: A boxed warning covers suicidal thoughts in pediatric patients 6 years of age and older. Contraindicated with MAO inhibitors within 14 days and in narrow angle glaucoma; nausea, vomiting and fatigue are common.
clues.indication: Treatment of attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder in adults and in pediatric patients 6 years of age and older.
clues.mechanism: It is thought to act through selective inhibition of the pre-synaptic norepinephrine transporter, shown in ex vivo uptake studies.

tell: Its CYP2D6 poor metabolizers have a 21.6-hour half-life, against 5.2 hours in other patients.
